title: Adi-lila, chapter 6. Determining the Truth of Śrī Advaita
html:
“Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta”
Ādi-līlā
Chapter 6
Determining the Truth of Śrī Advaita
(English translation from the Bengali, following the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition and the Anubhāṣya, 2026)

বন্দে তং শ্রীমদদ্বৈতাচার্য্যমদ্ভুতচেষ্টিতম্ ৷
যস্য প্রসাদাদজ্ঞোঽপি তৎস্বরূপং নিরূপয়েৎ ॥ ১ ॥

vande taṁ śrīmad-advaitā-
I bow to Him Śrī Advaita-
cāryam adbhuta-ceṣṭitam
Ācārya wondrous (whose) deeds
yasya prasādād ajño ’pi
by whose grace an ignorant one even
tat-svarūpaṁ nirūpayet
His true nature may describe

1I bow to Śrī Advaita Ācārya, whose deeds are wondrous. By His grace even an ignorant person may describe His true nature.

জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য জয় নিত্যানন্দ ৷
জয়াদ্বৈতচন্দ্র জয় গৌরভক্তবৃন্দ ॥ ২ ॥

jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda
glory glory to Śrī Caitanya glory to Nityānanda
jayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
glory to Advaitacandra glory of Gaura the devotees to the multitude

2Glory, glory to Śrī Caitanya! Glory to Nityānanda! Glory to Advaitacandra! Glory to all the devotees of Gaura!

পঞ্চ শ্লোকে কহিল শ্রীনিত্যানন্দ-তত্ত্ব ৷
শ্লোকদ্বয়ে কহি অদ্বৈতাচার্য্যের মহত্ত্ব ॥ ৩ ॥

pañca śloke kahila śrī-nityānanda-tattva
in five verses I have told of Śrī Nityānanda the truth
śloka-dvaye kahi advaitācāryera mahattva
in two verses I tell of Advaita Ācārya the greatness

3In five verses I have set out the truth of Śrī Nityānanda; now in two I speak of the greatness of Advaita Ācārya.

মহাবিষ্ণুর্জগৎকর্ত্তা মায়য়া যঃ সৃজত্যদঃ ৷
তস্যাবতার এবায়মদ্বৈতাচার্য্য ঈশ্বরঃ ॥ ৪ ॥

mahā-viṣṇur jagat-kartā
Mahā-Viṣṇu of the world the maker
māyayā yaḥ sṛjaty adaḥ
by māyā who creates this (world)
tasyāvatāra evāyam
His avatāra indeed this
advaitācārya īśvaraḥ
Advaita Ācārya the Lord

4Mahā-Viṣṇu is the maker of the world, who creates it through māyā; and this Lord Advaita Ācārya is His avatāra.1

অদ্বৈতং হরিণাদ্বৈতাদাচার্য্যং ভক্তিশংসনাৎ ৷
ভক্তাবতারমীশং তমদ্বৈতাচার্য্যমাশ্রয়ে ॥ ৫ ॥

advaitaṁ hariṇādvaitād
Advaita from Hari being non-different
ācāryaṁ bhakti-śaṁsanāt
Ācārya bhakti from teaching
bhaktāvatāram īśaṁ tam
as a devotee descended the Lord Him
advaitācāryam āśraye
Advaita Ācārya I take shelter of

5He is called Advaita because He is non-different from Hari, and Ācārya because He teaches bhakti. I take shelter of Him, the Lord Advaita Ācārya, who has descended as a devotee.2

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য্য গোসাঞি সাক্ষাৎ ঈশ্বর ৷
যাঁহার মহিমা নহে জীবের গোচর ॥ ৬ ॥

advaita-ācārya gosāñi sākṣāt īśvara
Advaita Ācārya Gosāñi Himself the Lord
yām̐hāra mahimā nahe jīvera gocara
whose greatness not of the jīva within the range

6Advaita Ācārya Gosāñi is the Lord Himself; His greatness lies beyond the reach of the jīva.

মহাবিষ্ণু সৃষ্টি করেন জগদাদি কার্য্য ৷
তাঁর অবতার সাক্ষাৎ অদ্বৈত আচার্য্য ॥ ৭ ॥

mahā-viṣṇu sṛṣṭi karena jagad-ādi kārya
Mahā-Viṣṇu creation performs of the world and other works
tām̐ra avatāra sākṣāt advaita ācārya
His avatāra direct Advaita Ācārya

7Mahā-Viṣṇu carries out the creation of the world and all that goes with it, and Advaita Ācārya is His direct avatāra.

যে পুরুষ সৃষ্টি-স্থিতি করেন মায়ায় ৷
অনন্ত ব্রহ্মাণ্ড সৃষ্টি করেন লীলায় ॥ ৮ ॥

ye puruṣa sṛṣṭi-sthiti karena māyāya
which Puruṣa creation and maintenance performs through māyā
ananta brahmāṇḍa sṛṣṭi karena līlāya
endless universes creation performs in play

8That Puruṣa creates and maintains the world through māyā, and in play He brings forth endless universes.

ইচ্ছায় অনন্ত মূর্ত্তি করেন প্রকাশ ৷
এক এক মূর্ত্ত্যে করেন ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে প্রবেশ ॥ ৯ ॥

icchāya ananta mūrti karena prakāśa
by His will endless forms He makes manifest
eka eka mūrtye karena brahmāṇḍe praveśa
in one one form (each) He makes into a universe entrance

9By His will He manifests endless forms, and in one of them He enters each universe.

সে পুরুষের অংশ — অদ্বৈত, নাহি কিছু ভেদ ৷
শরীর-বিশেষ তাঁর — নাহিক বিচ্ছেদ ॥ ১০ ॥

se puruṣera aṁśa — advaita, nāhi kichu bheda
of that Puruṣa a part Advaita there is not any difference
śarīra-viśeṣa tām̐ra — nāhika viccheda
a particular body His there is no separation

10Advaita is a part (aṁśa) of that Puruṣa, and there is no difference between Them at all: He is a particular body of the Puruṣa, and the two are never apart.3

সহায় করেন তাঁর লইয়া ‘প্রধান’ ৷
কোটি ব্রহ্মাণ্ড করেন ইচ্ছায় নির্ম্মাণ ॥ ১১ ॥

sahāya karena tām̐ra laiyā ‘pradhāna’
help He gives to Him taking pradhāna
koṭi brahmāṇḍa karena icchāya nirmāṇa
millions of universes He makes by His will the fashioning

11Taking pradhāna, the material basis of the world, Advaita assists the Puruṣa, and by His will He fashions millions of universes.4

জগৎ-মঙ্গল অদ্বৈত, মঙ্গল-গুণধাম ৷
মঙ্গল-চরিত্র সদা, ‘মঙ্গল’ যাঁর নাম ॥ ১২ ॥

jagat-maṅgala advaita, maṅgala-guṇa-dhāma
of the world the good Advaita of auspicious qualities the abode
maṅgala-caritra sadā, ‘maṅgala’ yām̐ra nāma
auspicious conduct always ‘Maṅgala’ whose name

12Advaita is the good of the whole world and the abode of all auspicious qualities. His conduct is ever auspicious, and His name is Maṅgala, “the Auspicious”.5

কোটি অংশ, কোটি শক্তি, কোটি অবতার ৷
এত লঞা সৃজে পুরুষ সকল সংসার ॥ ১৩ ॥

koṭi aṁśa, koṭi śakti, koṭi avatāra
millions of parts millions of potencies millions of avatāras
eta lañā sṛje puruṣa sakala saṁsāra
so many taking creates the Puruṣa the whole world

13Taking millions of parts, millions of potencies and millions of avatāras, the Puruṣa creates the whole world.

মায়া যৈছে দুই অংশ — ‘নিমিত্ত’, ‘উপাদান’ ৷
মায়া — ‘নিমিত্ত’-হেতু, উপাদান — ‘প্রধান’ ॥ ১৪ ॥

māyā yaiche dui aṁśa — ‘nimitta’, ‘upādāna’
māyā as two aspects efficient material
māyā — ‘nimitta’-hetu, upādāna — ‘pradhāna’
māyā the efficient cause the material pradhāna

14Māyā has two aspects, the efficient cause (nimitta) and the material cause (upādāna): as the efficient cause it is called māyā, and as the material cause, pradhāna.

পুরুষ ঈশ্বর ঐছে দ্বিমূর্ত্তি হইয়া ৷
বিশ্ব-সৃষ্টি করে ‘নিমিত্ত’ ‘উপাদান’ লঞা ॥ ১৫ ॥

puruṣa īśvara aiche dvi-mūrti haiyā
the Puruṣa the Lord likewise two forms becoming
viśva-sṛṣṭi kare ‘nimitta’ ‘upādāna’ lañā
of the universe creation performs the efficient the material taking

15In the same way the Lord, the Puruṣa, assumes two forms and creates the universe with these two causes, the efficient and the material.

আপনে পুরুষ — বিশ্বের ‘নিমিত্ত’-কারণ ৷
অদ্বৈত-রূপে ‘উপাদান’ হন নারায়ণ ॥ ১৬ ॥

āpane puruṣa — viśvera ‘nimitta’-kāraṇa
Himself the Puruṣa of the world the efficient cause
advaita-rūpe ‘upādāna’ hana nārāyaṇa
of Advaita in the form the material cause becomes Nārāyaṇa

16The Puruṣa Himself is the efficient cause of the world, and in the form of Advaita, Nārāyaṇa becomes its material cause.

‘নিমিত্তাংশে’ করে তেঁহো মায়াতে ঈক্ষণ ৷
‘উপাদান’ অদ্বৈত করেন ব্রহ্মাণ্ড-সৃজন ॥ ১৭ ॥

‘nimittāṁśe’ kare tem̐ho māyāte īkṣaṇa
in the efficient aspect performs He upon māyā the glance
‘upādāna’ advaita karena brahmāṇḍa-sṛjana
as the material cause Advaita performs of the universe the creation

17As the efficient cause He casts His glance upon māyā; as the material cause, Advaita creates the universe.

যদ্যপি সাংখ্য মানে, ‘প্রধান’ — কারণ ৷
জড় হইতে কভু নহে জগৎ-সৃজন ॥ ১৮ ॥

yadyapi sāṅkhya māne, ‘pradhāna’ — kāraṇa
although Sāṅkhya holds pradhāna the cause
jaḍa haite kabhu nahe jagat-sṛjana
from inert matter never is of the world the creation

18Although Sāṅkhya holds pradhāna to be the cause, the world can never come into being from inert matter.6

নিজ সৃষ্টিশক্তি প্রভু সঞ্চারে প্রধানে ৷
ঈশ্বরের শক্ত্যে তবে হয়ে ত’ নির্ম্মাণে ॥ ১৯ ॥

nija sṛṣṭi-śakti prabhu sañcāre pradhāne
His own creative power the Lord infuses into pradhāna
īśvarera śaktye tabe haye ta’ nirmāṇe
of the Lord by the power then takes place indeed the fashioning

19The Lord infuses His own creative power into pradhāna, and by that power the world is fashioned.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য্য — কোটিব্রহ্মাণ্ডের কর্ত্তা ৷
আর এক এক মূর্ত্ত্যে ব্রহ্মাণ্ডের ভর্ত্তা ॥ ২০ ॥

advaita-ācārya — koṭi-brahmāṇḍera kartā
Advaita Ācārya of millions of universes the creator
āra eka eka mūrtye brahmāṇḍera bhartā
and in one one form (each) of the universe the sustainer

20Advaita Ācārya creates millions of universes, and in each of them He dwells in one of His forms as its sustainer.7

সেই নারায়ণের মুখ্য অঙ্গ, — অদ্বৈত ৷
‘অঙ্গ’ শব্দে অংশ করি’ কহে ভাগবত ॥ ২১ ॥

sei nārāyaṇera mukhya aṅga, — advaita
of that Nārāyaṇa the principal limb Advaita
‘aṅga’ śabde aṁśa kari’ kahe bhāgavata
‘aṅga’ by the word part meaning says the Bhāgavata

21Advaita is the principal limb (aṅga) of Śrī Nārāyaṇa; and in the Bhāgavatam the word ‘aṅga’ means ‘aṁśa’, a partial manifestation.8

নারায়ণস্ত্বং ন হি সর্ব্বদেহিনা-
মাত্মাস্যধীশাখিললোকসাক্ষী ৷
নারায়ণোঽঙ্গং নরভূজলায়না-
ত্তচ্চাপি সত্যং ন তবৈব মায়া ॥ ২২ ॥

nārāyaṇas tvaṁ na hi sarva-dehinām
Nārāyaṇa You not indeed of all the embodied
ātmāsy adhīśākhila-loka-sākṣī
the Self You are O Lord of all worlds the witness
nārāyaṇo ’ṅgaṁ nara-bhū-jalāyanāt
Nārāyaṇa (Your) limb from Nara born waters abode
tac cāpi satyaṁ na tavaiva māyā
that also true not Your indeed māyā

22“Are You not Nārāyaṇa? For You are the Self of all embodied beings, O Lord, and the witness of all the worlds. Nārāyaṇa is Your portion — so called because His abode is the waters born of Nara; and that too is true, not Your māyā.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.14.14)9

ঈশ্বরের ‘অঙ্গ’, অংশ — চিদানন্দময় ৷
মায়ার সম্বন্ধ নাহি, এই শ্লোকে কয় ॥ ২৩ ॥

īśvarera ‘aṅga’, aṁśa — cid-ānanda-maya
of the Lord the aṅga the aṁśa full of consciousness and bliss
māyāra sambandha nāhi, ei śloke kaya
with māyā connection there is not this verse says

23This verse says that the Lord’s aṅga, His aṁśa, is full of consciousness and bliss and has no connection with māyā.10

‘অংশ’ না কহিয়া, কেনে কহ তাঁরে ‘অঙ্গ’ ৷
‘অংশ’ হৈতে ‘অঙ্গ,’ যাতে হয় অন্তরঙ্গ ॥ ২৪ ॥

‘aṁśa’ nā kahiyā, kene kaha tām̐re ‘aṅga’
‘aṁśa’ not saying why do you call Him ‘aṅga’
‘aṁśa’ haite ‘aṅga,’ yāte haya antaraṅga
than ‘aṁśa’ ‘aṅga’ because is more intimate

24Why call Him ‘aṅga’ and not ‘aṁśa’? Because ‘aṅga’, a limb, is closer and more intimate than ‘aṁśa’, a part.

মহাবিষ্ণুর অংশ — অদ্বৈত গুণধাম ৷
ঈশ্বরে অভেদ, তেঞি ‘অদ্বৈত’ পূর্ণ নাম ॥ ২৫ ॥

mahā-viṣṇura aṁśa — advaita guṇa-dhāma
of Mahā-Viṣṇu a part Advaita of qualities the abode
īśvare abheda, teñi ‘advaita’ pūrṇa nāma
from the Lord non-different therefore ‘Advaita’ full name

25Advaita, the abode of all good qualities, is a part of Mahā-Viṣṇu. He is non-different from the Lord, and so the name Advaita, “Non-dual”, fits Him in full.11

পূর্ব্বে যৈছে কৈল সর্ব্ব বিশ্বের-সৃজন ৷
অবতরি’ কৈল এবে ভক্তি-প্রবর্ত্তন ॥ ২৬ ॥

pūrve yaiche kaila sarva viśvera-sṛjana
before as He performed of the whole universe the creation
avatari’ kaila ebe bhakti-pravartana
having descended He performed now of bhakti the establishment

26As once He created the whole universe, so now, having descended, He has established bhakti.

জীব নিস্তারিল কৃষ্ণভক্তি করি’ দান ৷
গীতা-ভাগবতে কৈল ভক্তির ব্যাখ্যান ॥ ২৭ ॥

jīva nistārila kṛṣṇa-bhakti kari’ dāna
the jīvas He delivered devotion to Kṛṣṇa making a gift
gītā-bhāgavate kaila bhaktira vyākhyāna
in the Gītā and Bhāgavata He gave of bhakti the explanation

27He delivered the jīvas by giving them devotion to Kṛṣṇa, and He explained the Gītā and the Bhāgavatam in the light of bhakti.

ভক্তি-উপদেশ বিনু তাঁর নাহি কার্য্য ৷
অতএব নাম হৈল ‘অদ্বৈত আচার্য্য’ ॥ ২৮ ॥

bhakti-upadeśa vinu tām̐ra nāhi kārya
bhakti teaching except His there is no work
ataeva nāma haila ‘advaita ācārya’
therefore name became ‘Advaita Ācārya’

28He has no work but teaching bhakti; therefore His name became Advaita Ācārya.12

বৈষ্ণবের গুরু তেঁহো জগতের আর্য্য ৷
দুইনাম-মিলনে হৈল ‘অদ্বৈত-আচার্য্য’ ॥ ২৯ ॥

vaiṣṇavera guru tem̐ho jagatera ārya
of the Vaiṣṇavas the guru He of the world the venerable
dui-nāma-milane haila ‘advaita-ācārya’
two names by joining became ‘Advaita Ācārya’

29He is the guru of the Vaiṣṇavas, honoured by the whole world. Joined together, these two names became Advaita Ācārya.

কমল-নয়নের তেঁহো, যাতে ‘অঙ্গ’, ‘অংশ’ ৷
‘কমলাক্ষ’ বলি’ ধরে নাম অবতংস ॥ ৩০ ॥

kamala-nayanera tem̐ho, yāte ‘aṅga’, ‘aṁśa’
of the Lotus-eyed He because ‘aṅga’ ‘aṁśa’
‘kamalākṣa’ bali’ dhare nāma avataṁsa
‘Kamalākṣa’ calling He bears the name as a crown-jewel

30Because He is the limb and the part of the Lotus-eyed Lord, He bears the beautiful name Kamalākṣa, “Lotus-eyed”.13

ঈশ্বরসারূপ্য পায় পারিষদগণ ৷
চতুর্ভুজ, পীতবাস, যৈছে নারায়ণ ॥ ৩১ ॥

īśvara-sārūpya pāya pāriṣada-gaṇa
with the Lord sameness of form attain the associates
catur-bhuja, pīta-vāsa, yaiche nārāyaṇa
four-armed yellow-clad just as Nārāyaṇa

31The Lord’s associates attain a form like His (sārūpya): like Nārāyaṇa, they are four-armed and clad in yellow.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য্য — ঈশ্বরের অংশবর্য্য ৷
তাঁর তত্ত্ব-নাম-গুণ, সকলি আশ্চর্য্য ॥ ৩২ ॥

advaita-ācārya — īśvarera aṁśa-varya
Advaita Ācārya of the Lord part the foremost
tām̐ra tattva-nāma-guṇa, sakali āścarya
His truth name qualities all wondrous

32Advaita Ācārya is the foremost part of the Lord; His truth, His name and His qualities are all wondrous.

যাঁহার তুলসীদলে, যাঁহার হুঙ্কারে ৷
স্বগণ সহিতে চৈতন্যের অবতারে ॥ ৩৩ ॥

yām̐hāra tulasī-dale, yām̐hāra huṅkāre
by whose tulasī leaves by whose roar
sva-gaṇa sahite caitanyera avatāre
His associates together with Caitanya’s descent

33It was His offering of tulasī leaves and His roar that brought Caitanya into the world together with His associates.14

যাঁর দ্বারা কৈল প্রভু কীর্ত্তন প্রচার ৷
যাঁর দ্বারা কৈল প্রভু জগৎ নিস্তার ॥ ৩৪ ॥

yām̐ra dvārā kaila prabhu kīrtana pracāra
through whom made the Lord of kīrtana the spreading
yām̐ra dvārā kaila prabhu jagat nistāra
through whom made the Lord of the world the deliverance

34Through Him the Lord spread the kīrtana, and through Him the Lord delivered the world.

আচার্য্য গোসাঞির গুণ-মহিমা অপার ৷
জীবকীট কোথায় পাইবেক তার পার ॥ ৩৫ ॥

ācārya gosāñira guṇa-mahimā apāra
of Ācārya Gosāñi of the qualities the glory boundless
jīva-kīṭa kothāya pāibeka tāra pāra
the worm-like jīva where will find of it the end

35The glory of Ācārya Gosāñi’s qualities is boundless. Where can the jīva, a mere worm, find its end?

আচার্য্য গোসাঞি চৈতন্যের মুখ্য অঙ্গ ৷
আর এক অঙ্গ তাঁর প্রভু নিত্যানন্দ ॥ ৩৬ ॥

ācārya gosāñi caitanyera mukhya aṅga
Ācārya Gosāñi Caitanya’s principal limb
āra eka aṅga tām̐ra prabhu nityānanda
another one limb His Prabhu Nityānanda

36Ācārya Gosāñi is the principal limb (aṅga) of Caitanya, and His other limb is Nityānanda Prabhu.15

প্রভুর উপাঙ্গ — শ্রীবাসাদি ভক্তগণ ৷
হস্তমুখনেত্র-অঙ্গ চক্রাদ্যস্ত্র-সম ॥ ৩৭ ॥

prabhura upāṅga — śrīvāsādi bhakta-gaṇa
the Lord’s lesser limbs Śrīvāsa and the other devotees
hasta-mukha-netra-aṅga cakrādy-astra-sama
hands face eyes limbs disc and other weapons like

37The Lord’s lesser limbs (upāṅga) are Śrīvāsa and the other devotees; they are like His hands, face and eyes, and like His disc and other weapons.

এসব লইয়া চৈতন্যপ্রভুর বিহার ৷
এসব লইয়া করেন বাঞ্ছিত-প্রচার ॥ ৩৮ ॥

esaba laiyā caitanya-prabhura vihāra
with all these taking Caitanya Prabhu’s pastimes
esaba laiyā karena vāñchita-pracāra
with all these taking He makes of His desire the spreading

38With them Caitanya Prabhu performs His pastimes, and with them He spreads what He desires.

মাধবেন্দ্রপুরীর ইঁহো শিষ্য, এই জ্ঞানে ৷
আচার্য্য-গোসাঞিরে প্রভু গুরু করি’ মানে ॥ ৩৯ ॥

mādhavendrapurīra im̐ho śiṣya, ei jñāne
of Mādhavendra Purī He the disciple with this understanding
ācārya-gosāñire prabhu guru kari’ māne
Ācārya Gosāñi the Lord as guru regards

39Knowing that He is a disciple of Mādhavendra Purī, the Lord regards Ācārya Gosāñi as His guru.16

লৌকিক-লীলাতে ধর্ম্মমর্য্যাদা-রক্ষণ ৷
স্তুতি-ভক্ত্যে করে তাঁর চরণ-বন্দন ॥ ৪০ ॥

laukika-līlāte dharma-maryādā-rakṣaṇa
in worldly pastimes of dharma’s bounds the keeping
stuti-bhaktye kare tām̐ra caraṇa-vandana
with praise and devotion He makes His to the feet obeisance

40In His worldly pastimes the Lord keeps the bounds of dharma: with praise and devotion He bows at the Ācārya’s feet.

চৈতন্য-গোসাঞিকে আচার্য্য করে ‘প্রভু’ জ্ঞান ৷
আপনাকে করেন তাঁর ‘দাস’ অভিমান ॥ ৪১ ॥

caitanya-gosāñike ācārya kare ‘prabhu’ jñāna
Caitanya Gosāñi the Ācārya holds as ‘Master’
āpanāke karena tām̐ra ‘dāsa’ abhimāna
Himself He holds His ‘servant’ in self-conception

41The Ācārya knows Caitanya Gosāñi as His Master, and He thinks of Himself as His servant.

সেই অভিমান-সুখে আপনা পাসরে ৷
‘কৃষ্ণদাস’ হও — জীবে উপদেশ করে ॥ ৪২ ॥

sei abhimāna-sukhe āpanā pāsare
in that self-conception’s happiness Himself He forgets
‘kṛṣṇa-dāsa’ hao — jīve upadeśa kare
‘Kṛṣṇa’s servant’ become to the jīvas instruction He gives

42In the happiness of that feeling He forgets Himself, and He teaches the jīvas, “Become servants of Kṛṣṇa!”17

কৃষ্ণদাস-অভিমানে যে আনন্দসিন্ধু ৷
কোটি-ব্রহ্মসুখ নহে তার এক বিন্দু ॥ ৪৩ ॥

kṛṣṇa-dāsa-abhimāne ye ānanda-sindhu
of Kṛṣṇa’s servant in the self-conception which of bliss the ocean
koṭi-brahma-sukha nahe tāra eka bindu
millions of times Brahman’s happiness is not of it one drop

43Such is the ocean of bliss in feeling oneself Kṛṣṇa’s servant that the happiness of Brahman, multiplied ten million times, is not equal to a single drop of it.18

মুঞি যে চৈতন্যদাস, আর নিত্যানন্দ ৷
দাস-ভাব-সম নহে অন্যত্র আনন্দ ॥ ৪৪ ॥

muñi ye caitanya-dāsa, āra nityānanda
I indeed Caitanya’s servant and Nityānanda
dāsa-bhāva-sama nahe anyatra ānanda
of the servant’s mood equal there is not elsewhere bliss

44“I and Nityānanda are servants of Caitanya. Nowhere is there bliss equal to the mood of a servant.”

পরমপ্রেয়সী লক্ষ্মী হৃদয়ে বসতি ৷
তেঁহো দাস্য-সুখ মাগে করিয়া মিনতি ॥ ৪৫ ॥

parama-preyasī lakṣmī hṛdaye vasati
supreme beloved Lakṣmī on His heart dwells
tem̐ho dāsya-sukha māge kariyā minati
she of service the happiness begs making entreaty

45Lakṣmī, His dearest beloved, dwells upon His heart, yet she too humbly begs for the happiness of service.

দাস্য-ভাবে আনন্দিত পারিষদগণ ৷
বিধি-ভব-নারদাদি-শুক-সনাতন ॥ ৪৬ ॥

dāsya-bhāve ānandita pāriṣada-gaṇa
in the mood of service rejoice the associates
vidhi-bhava-nāradādi-śuka-sanātana
Brahmā Śiva Nārada and others Śuka Sanātana (and the other Kumāras)

46In the mood of service His associates rejoice — Brahmā, Śiva, Nārada and others, Śuka, and Sanātana with his brothers.19

নিত্যানন্দ অবধূত সবাতে আগল ৷
চৈতন্যের দাস্য-প্রেমে হইল পাগল ॥ ৪৭ ॥

nityānanda avadhūta sabāte āgala
Nityānanda Avadhūta among all the foremost
caitanyera dāsya-preme haila pāgala
Caitanya’s in the love of service became mad

47Nityānanda Avadhūta is the foremost of all; in His love of serving Caitanya He became mad.20

শ্রীবাস, হরিদাস, রামদাস, গদাধর ৷
মুরারি, মুকুন্দ, চন্দ্রশেখর, বক্রেশ্বর ॥ ৪৮ ॥

এসব পণ্ডিতলোক পরম-মহত্ত্ব ৷
চৈতন্যের দাস্যে সবায় করয়ে উন্মত্ত ॥ ৪৯ ॥

śrīvāsa, haridāsa, rāmadāsa, gadādhara
Śrīvāsa Haridāsa Rāmadāsa Gadādhara
murāri, mukunda, candraśekhara, vakreśvara
Murāri Mukunda Candraśekhara Vakreśvara
esaba paṇḍita-loka parama-mahattva
all these learned men of supreme greatness
caitanyera dāsye sabāya karaye unmatta
Caitanya’s service all of them makes mad

48–49Śrīvāsa, Haridāsa, Rāmadāsa, Gadādhara, Murāri, Mukunda, Candraśekhara and Vakreśvara — all these are learned men of the highest greatness, and service to Caitanya makes every one of them mad.

এইমত গায়, নাচে, করে অট্টহাস ৷
লোকে উপদেশে, — ‘হও চৈতন্যের দাস’ ॥ ৫০ ॥

ei mata gāya, nāce, kare aṭṭahāsa
in this way they sing dance make loud laughter
loke upadeśe, — ‘hao caitanyera dāsa’
people they teach ‘become Caitanya’s servants’

50So they sing, dance and laugh aloud, and they teach everyone: “Become servants of Caitanya!”

চৈতন্যগোসাঞি মোরে করে গুরু-জ্ঞান ৷
তথাপিহ মোর হয় ‘দাস’ অভিমান ॥ ৫১ ॥

caitanyagosāñi more kare guru-jñāna
Caitanya Gosāñi Me holds as guru
tathāpiha mora haya ‘dāsa’ abhimāna
still My is ‘servant’ self-conception

51“Caitanya Gosāñi regards Me as His guru, yet I feel Myself His servant.”

কৃষ্ণপ্রেমের এই এক অপূর্ব্ব প্রভাব ৷
গুরু-সম-লঘুকে করায় দাস্যভাব ॥ ৫২ ॥

kṛṣṇa-premera ei eka apūrva prabhāva
of Kṛṣṇa-prema this one unprecedented power
guru-sama-laghuke karāya dāsya-bhāva
elders equals juniors makes feel the mood of service

52This is one wondrous power of love for Kṛṣṇa: it gives elders, equals and juniors alike the mood of a servant.21

ইহার প্রমাণ শুন শাস্ত্রের ব্যাখ্যান ৷
মহদনুভব যাতে সুদৃঢ় প্রমাণ ॥ ৫৩ ॥

ihāra pramāṇa śuna śāstrera vyākhyāna
of this the proof hear of the scriptures the explanation
mahad-anubhava yāte sudṛḍha pramāṇa
of great souls the experience in which firm proof

53Hear the proof of this in the explanations of scripture, firmly confirmed by the experience of great souls.

অন্যের কা কথা, ব্রজে নন্দ মহাশয় ৷
তাঁর সম ‘গুরু’ কৃষ্ণের আর কেহ নয় ॥ ৫৪ ॥

শুদ্ধবাৎসল্যে ঈশ্বর-জ্ঞান নাহি তাঁর ৷
তাঁহাকেই প্রেমে করায় দাস্য-অনুকার ॥ ৫৫ ॥

anyera kā kathā, vraje nanda mahāśaya
of others what to speak in Vraja Nanda Mahāśaya
tām̐ra sama ‘guru’ kṛṣṇera āra keha naya
his equal elder of Kṛṣṇa other anyone is not
śuddha-vātsalye īśvara-jñāna nāhi tām̐ra
in pure parental love of God the knowledge is not his
tām̐hākei preme karāya dāsya-anukāra
him even love makes feel of service a semblance

54–55What to speak of others? In Vraja Kṛṣṇa has no elder equal to Nanda Mahāśaya. In his pure parental love he has no thought that Kṛṣṇa is God; yet love makes even him feel something like a servant.22

তেঁহো রতি-মতি মাগে কৃষ্ণের চরণে ৷
তাহার শ্রীমুখবাণী তাহাতে প্রমাণে ॥ ৫৬ ॥

tem̐ho rati-mati māge kṛṣṇera caraṇe
he attraction devotion begs at Kṛṣṇa’s feet
tāhāra śrī-mukha-vāṇī tāhāte pramāṇe
his holy lips’ words of that the proof

56He too begs at Kṛṣṇa’s feet for attachment and devotion; his own words are the proof of it.

শুন উদ্ধব, সত্য, কৃষ্ণ, — আমার তনয় ৷
তেঁহো ঈশ্বর — হেন যদি তোমার মনে লয় ॥ ৫৭ ॥

তথাপি তাঁহাতে রহু মোর মনোবৃত্তি ৷
তোমার ঈশ্বর-কৃষ্ণে হউক মোর মতি ॥ ৫৮ ॥

śuna uddhava, satya, kṛṣṇa, — āmāra tanaya
hear Uddhava truly Kṛṣṇa my son
tem̐ho īśvara — hena yadi tomāra mane laya
He God thus if your mind takes
tathāpi tām̐hāte rahu mora mano-vṛtti
still in Him may remain my mind’s workings
tomāra īśvara-kṛṣṇe hauka mora mati
in your God Kṛṣṇa may be my thought

57–58“Listen, Uddhava: Kṛṣṇa is truly my son. But if it seems to you that He is God, still let all the workings of my mind rest in Him; let my thoughts be fixed on your God, Kṛṣṇa.”23

মনসো বৃত্তয়ো নঃ স্যুঃ কৃষ্ণপাদাম্বুজাশ্রয়াঃ ৷
বাচোঽভিধায়িনীর্নাম্নাং কায়স্তৎপ্রহ্বণাদিষু ॥ ৫৯ ॥

manaso vṛttayo naḥ syuḥ
of the mind the workings our may be
kṛṣṇa-pādāmbujāśrayāḥ
of Kṛṣṇa’s lotus feet taking shelter
vāco ’bhidhāyinīr nāmnāṁ
our words uttering His names
kāyas tat-prahvaṇādiṣu
the body in bowing to Him and the like

59“May the workings of our minds take shelter at Kṛṣṇa’s lotus feet, may our words utter His names, and may our bodies be given to bowing down to Him and serving Him.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.47.66)24

কর্ম্মভির্ভ্রাম্যমাণানাং যত্র ক্বাপীশ্বরেচ্ছয়া ৷
মঙ্গলাচরিতৈর্দানৈ রতির্নঃ কৃষ্ণ ঈশ্বরে ॥ ৬০ ॥

karmabhir bhrāmyamāṇānāṁ
by our karma being made to wander
yatra kvāpīśvarecchayā
wherever by the Lord’s will
maṅgalācaritair dānai
by auspicious deeds by gifts
ratir naḥ kṛṣṇa īśvare
love our for Kṛṣṇa the Lord

60“Wherever we may wander, driven by our karma and the Lord’s will, by our good deeds and gifts may we have love for Kṛṣṇa, the Lord.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.47.67)

শ্রীদামাদি ব্রজে যত সখার নিচয় ৷
ঐশ্বর্য্য-জ্ঞান-হীন, কেবল-সখ্যময় ॥ ৬১ ॥

śrīdāmādi vraje yata sakhāra nicaya
Śrīdāmā and others in Vraja all of friends the host
aiśvarya-jñāna-hīna, kevala-sakhya-maya
of majesty the knowledge without purely of friendship made

61All the host of Kṛṣṇa’s friends in Vraja, led by Śrīdāmā, know nothing of His majesty: their love is pure friendship.25

কৃষ্ণসঙ্গে যুদ্ধ করে, স্কন্ধে আরোহণ ৷
তাঁরা দাস্যভাবে করে চরণ-সেবন ॥ ৬২ ॥

kṛṣṇa-saṅge yuddha kare, skandhe ārohaṇa
with Kṛṣṇa together wrestling they do on His shoulders climbing
tām̐rā dāsya-bhāve kare caraṇa-sevana
they in the mood of service do to His feet service

62They wrestle with Kṛṣṇa and climb on His shoulders, and yet, in the mood of servants, they tend His feet.26

পাদসম্বাহনং চক্রুঃ কেচিত্তস্য মহাত্মনঃ ৷
অপরে হতপাপ্মানো ব্যজনৈঃ সমবীজয়ন্ ॥ ৬৩ ॥

pāda-saṁvāhanaṁ cakruḥ
of the feet massage performed
kecit tasya mahātmanaḥ
some His of the great soul
apare hata-pāpmāno
others free from sin
vyajanaiḥ samavījayan
with fans fanned (Him)

63“Some of them massaged the feet of that great soul, while others, their sins destroyed, fanned Him with fans.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.15.17)27

কৃষ্ণের প্রেয়সী ব্রজে যত গোপীগণ ৷
যাঁর পদধূলি করে উদ্ধব প্রার্থন ॥ ৬৪ ॥

যাঁ-সবার উপরে কৃষ্ণের প্রিয় নাহি আন ৷
তাঁহারা আপনাকে করে দাসী-অভিমান ॥ ৬৫ ॥

kṛṣṇera preyasī vraje yata gopī-gaṇa
Kṛṣṇa’s beloved in Vraja all the gopīs
yām̐ra pada-dhūli kare uddhava prārthana
whose feet’s dust does Uddhava pray for
yām̐-sabāra upare kṛṣṇera priya nāhi āna
than all of them more to Kṛṣṇa dear is not another
tām̐hārā āpanāke kare dāsī-abhimāna
they themselves hold as maidservants in self-conception

64–65Even the beloved gopīs of Vraja, dearer to Kṛṣṇa than anyone else, whose foot-dust Uddhava prays for, think of themselves as His maidservants.

ব্রজজনার্ত্তিহন্ বীর যোষিতাং
নিজ-জনস্ময়ধ্বংসনস্মিত ৷
ভজ সখে ভবৎ কিঙ্করীঃ স্ম নো
জলরুহাননং চারু দর্শয় ॥ ৬৬ ॥

vraja-janārti-han vīra yoṣitāṁ
of Vraja’s people the distress O destroyer O hero of women
nija-janasmaya-dhvaṁsana-smita
of Your own people the pride destroying whose smile
bhaja sakhe bhavat kiṅkarīḥ sma no
accept O friend Your maidservants indeed us
jala-ruhānanaṁ cāru darśaya
lotus-like face beautiful show

66“O You who take away the distress of the people of Vraja! O Hero, whose smile destroys the pride of Your own! O friend, we are Your maidservants: be kind to us, and show us women Your beautiful lotus face.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.31.6)28

অপি বত মধুপুর্য্যামার্য্যপুত্রোঽধুনাস্তে
স্মরতি স পিতৃগেহান্ সৌম্য বন্ধূংশ্চ গোপান্ ৷
ক্বচিদপি স কথাং নঃ কিঙ্করীণাং গৃণীতে
ভুজমগুরুসুগন্ধং মূর্দ্ধ্ন্যধাস্যৎ কদা নু ॥ ৬৭ ॥

api bata madhu-puryām ārya-putro ’dhunāste
(is it) alas in Madhupurī the noble one’s son now dwells
smarati sa pitṛ-gehān saumya bandhūṁś ca gopān
remembers (does) He His father’s house O gentle one kinsmen and cowherds
kvacid api sa kathāṁ naḥ kiṅkarīṇāṁ gṛṇīte
ever (does) He talk of us maidservants speak
bhujam aguru-sugandhaṁ mūrdhny adhāsyat kadā nu
His arm aguru-fragrant on the head will He place when indeed

67“O gentle one! Alas, Nanda’s son now lives in Mathurā. Does He remember His father’s house, His kinsmen and the cowherd boys? Does He ever speak of us, His maidservants? When will He place on our heads His arm, fragrant as aguru?” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.47.21)29

তাঁ-সবার কথা রহু, — শ্রীমতী রাধিকা ৷
সবা হৈতে সকলাংশে পরম-অধিকা ॥ ৬৮ ॥

তেঁহো যাঁর দাসী হৈঞা সেবেন চরণ ৷
যাঁর প্রেমগুণে কৃষ্ণ বদ্ধ অনুক্ষণ ॥ ৬৯ ॥

tām̐-sabāra kathā rahu, — śrīmatī rādhikā
of all of them the talk let be Śrīmatī Rādhikā
sabā haite sakalāṁśe parama-adhikā
than all in every respect supremely greater
tem̐ho yām̐ra dāsī haiñā sevena caraṇa
She His maidservant becoming serves the feet
yām̐ra prema-guṇe kṛṣṇa baddha anukṣaṇa
by whose love’s qualities Kṛṣṇa bound always

68–69Let alone them: Śrīmatī Rādhikā, who surpasses them all in every respect and by whose love Kṛṣṇa is bound at every moment — even She has become His maidservant and serves His feet.30

হা নাথ রমণ প্রেষ্ঠ ক্বাসি ক্বাসি মহাভুজ ৷
দাস্যাস্তে কৃপণায়া মে সখে দর্শয় সন্নিধিম্ ॥ ৭০ ॥

hā nātha ramaṇa preṣṭha
O Master Beloved dearest
kvāsi kvāsi mahā-bhuja
where are You where are You O mighty-armed
dāsyās te kṛpaṇāyā me
to Your maidservant wretched to Me
sakhe darśaya sannidhim
O friend show Your nearness

70“O Master, O Beloved, O dearest one! Where are You, where are You, O mighty-armed? O friend, show Yourself to Me, Your wretched maidservant!” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.30.39)31

দ্বারকাতে রুক্মিণ্যাদি যতেক মহিষী ৷
তাঁহারাও আপনাকে মানে কৃষ্ণদাসী ॥ ৭১ ॥

dvārakāte rukmiṇyādi yateka mahiṣī
in Dvārakā Rukmiṇī and the other all queens
tām̐hārāo āpanāke māne kṛṣṇa-dāsī
they too themselves hold Kṛṣṇa’s maidservants

71In Dvārakā all the queens, led by Rukmiṇī, also think of themselves as Kṛṣṇa’s maidservants.

তপশ্চরন্তীমাজ্ঞায় স্বপাদস্পর্শনাশয়া ৷
সখ্যোপেত্যাগ্রহীৎ পাণিং সাহং তদ্গৃহমার্জ্জনী ॥ ৭২ ॥

tapaś carantīm ājñāya
austerity performing knowing (me)
sva-pāda-sparśanāśayā
His own feet of touching with the hope
sakhyopetyāgrahīt pāṇiṁ
with His friend coming took my hand
sāhaṁ tad-gṛha-mārjanī
that I His house the sweeper

72“Knowing that I was performing austerities in the hope of touching His feet, He came with His friend and took my hand. And so I am the sweeper of His house.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.83.11)32

আত্মারামস্য তস্যেমা বয়ং বৈ গৃহদাসিকাঃ ৷
সর্ব্বসঙ্গনিবৃত্ত্যাদ্ধা তপসা চ বভূবিম ॥ ৭৩ ॥

ātmārāmasya tasyemā
of the self-satisfied of Him these
vayaṁ vai gṛha-dāsikāḥ
we indeed household maidservants
sarva-saṅga-nivṛttyāddhā
from all attachments by turning away directly
tapasā ca babhūvima
by austerity and have become

73“By austerity and by turning away from every attachment, we have become, in truth, maidservants in the house of Him who delights in Himself.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 10.83.39)33

আনের কি কথা, বলদেব মহাশয় ৷
যাঁর ভাব — শুদ্ধসখ্য-বাৎসল্যাদিময় ॥ ৭৪ ॥

ānera ki kathā, baladeva mahāśaya
of others what to speak Baladeva Mahāśaya
yām̐ra bhāva — śuddha-sakhya-vātsalyādi-maya
whose mood of pure friendship parental love and the rest full

74What to speak of others? Consider Baladeva Mahāśaya, whose mood is full of pure friendship, parental love and the rest.34

তেঁহো আপনাকে করেন দাস-ভাবনা ৷
কৃষ্ণদাস-ভাব বিনু আছে কোন জনা ॥ ৭৫ ॥

tem̐ho āpanāke karena dāsa-bhāvanā
He Himself holds as a servant in thought
kṛṣṇa-dāsa-bhāva vinu āche kona janā
of Kṛṣṇa’s servant the mood without is there any person

75Even He thinks of Himself as a servant. Is there anyone without the mood of a servant of Kṛṣṇa?

সহস্র-বদনে যেঁহো শেষ-সঙ্কর্ষণ ৷
দশ দেহ ধরি’ করে কৃষ্ণের সেবন ॥ ৭৬ ॥

sahasra-vadane yem̐ho śeṣa-saṅkarṣaṇa
with a thousand mouths who Śeṣa-Saṅkarṣaṇa
daśa deha dhari’ kare kṛṣṇera sevana
ten bodies assuming does Kṛṣṇa’s service

76Śeṣa-Saṅkarṣaṇa, with His thousand mouths, assumes ten bodies and serves Kṛṣṇa.35

অনন্ত ব্রহ্মাণ্ডে রুদ্র — সদাশিবের অংশ ৷
গুণাবতার তেঁহো, সর্ব্বদেব-অবতংস ॥ ৭৭ ॥

ananta brahmāṇḍe rudra — sadāśivera aṁśa
in endless universes Rudra of Sadāśiva a part
guṇāvatāra tem̐ho, sarva-deva-avataṁsa
guṇa-avatāra he of all the gods the crown

77In the endless universes Rudra is a part of Sadāśiva; he is a guṇa-avatāra, the crown of all the gods.36

তেঁহো করেন কৃষ্ণের দাস্য-প্রত্যাশ ৷
নিরন্তর কহে শিব, ‘মুঞি কৃষ্ণদাস’ ॥ ৭৮ ॥

tem̐ho karena kṛṣṇera dāsya-pratyāśa
he makes of Kṛṣṇa’s service the hope
nirantara kahe śiva, ‘muñi kṛṣṇa-dāsa’
constantly says Śiva ‘I Kṛṣṇa’s servant’

78He longs for the service of Kṛṣṇa; Śiva says at every moment, “I am Kṛṣṇa’s servant.”

কৃষ্ণপ্রেমে উন্মত্ত, বিহ্বল দিগম্বর ৷
কৃষ্ণ-গুণ-লীলা গায়, নাচে নিরন্তর ॥ ৭৯ ॥

kṛṣṇa-preme unmatta, vihvala digambara
in Kṛṣṇa-prema mad overwhelmed naked
kṛṣṇa-guṇa-līlā gāya, nāce nirantara
Kṛṣṇa’s qualities pastimes he sings dances constantly

79Mad with love for Kṛṣṇa, overwhelmed and naked, he sings of Kṛṣṇa’s qualities and pastimes and dances without end.

পিতা-মাতা-গুরু-সখা-ভাব কেনে নয় ৷
কৃষ্ণপ্রেমের স্বভাবে দাস্য-ভাব সে করয় ॥ ৮০ ॥

pitā-mātā-guru-sakhā-bhāva kene naya
of father mother elder friend the mood whatever may be
kṛṣṇa-premera svabhāve dāsya-bhāva se karaya
of Kṛṣṇa-prema by the nature the mood of service it produces

80Whatever the mood — of father, mother, elder or friend — by the very nature of love for Kṛṣṇa it brings forth the mood of service.37

এক কৃষ্ণ — সর্ব্বসেব্য, জগৎ-ঈশ্বর ৷
আর যত সব, — তাঁর সেবকানুচর ॥ ৮১ ॥

eka kṛṣṇa — sarva-sevya, jagat-īśvara
one Kṛṣṇa served by all of the world the Lord
āra yata saba, — tām̐ra sevakānucara
and as many all His servants and followers

81Kṛṣṇa alone is served by all; He is the Lord of the world. All others are His servants and followers.

সেই কৃষ্ণ অবতীর্ণ — চৈতন্য-ঈশ্বর ৷
অতএব আর সব, — তাঁহার কিঙ্কর ॥ ৮২ ॥

sei kṛṣṇa avatīrṇa — caitanya-īśvara
that Kṛṣṇa descended Caitanya the Lord
ataeva āra saba, — tām̐hāra kiṅkara
therefore the rest all His servants

82That Kṛṣṇa has descended as the Lord Caitanya; therefore all others are His servants.

কেহ মানে, কেহ না মানে, সব তাঁর দাস ৷
যে না মানে, তার হয় সেই পাপে নাশ ॥ ৮৩ ॥

keha māne, keha nā māne, saba tām̐ra dāsa
some accept some not accept all His servants
ye nā māne, tāra haya sei pāpe nāśa
who not accepts of him is by that sin destruction

83Some accept Him and some do not, yet all are His servants. One who does not accept Him is destroyed by that very sin.38

চৈতন্যের দাস মুঞি, চৈতন্যের দাস ৷
চৈতন্যের দাস মুঞি, তাঁর দাসের দাস ॥ ৮৪ ॥

caitanyera dāsa muñi, caitanyera dāsa
Caitanya’s servant I Caitanya’s servant
caitanyera dāsa muñi, tām̐ra dāsera dāsa
Caitanya’s servant I His servants’ servant

84“I am Caitanya’s servant, Caitanya’s servant! I am Caitanya’s servant, the servant of His servants!”

এত বলি’ নাচে, গায়, হুঙ্কার গম্ভীর ৷
ক্ষণেকে বসিলা আচার্য্য হৈঞা সুস্থির ॥ ৮৫ ॥

eta bali’ nāce, gāya, huṅkāra gambhīra
so saying He dances sings roars deep
kṣaṇeke vasilā ācārya haiñā susthira
in a moment sat down the Ācārya becoming calm

85Saying this, He danced and sang with deep roars, and a moment later the Ācārya sat down, grown calm.

ভক্ত-অভিমান মূল শ্রীবলরামে ৷
সেই ভাবে অনুগত তাঁর অংশগণে ॥ ৮৬ ॥

bhakta-abhimāna mūla śrī-balarāme
the devotee’s self-conception the root in Śrī Balarāma
sei bhāve anugata tām̐ra aṁśa-gaṇe
that mood follow His parts

86The conception of oneself as a devotee has its root in Śrī Balarāma, and all His parts follow Him in that mood.39

তাঁর অবতার এক শ্রীসঙ্কর্ষণ ৷
ভক্ত বলি’ অভিমান করে সর্ব্বক্ষণ ॥ ৮৭ ॥

tām̐ra avatāra eka śrī-saṅkarṣaṇa
His avatāra one Śrī Saṅkarṣaṇa
bhakta bali’ abhimāna kare sarva-kṣaṇa
a devotee as self-conception holds at every moment

87One avatāra of His is Śrī Saṅkarṣaṇa, who at every moment thinks of Himself as a devotee.

তাঁর অবতার আন শ্রীযুত লক্ষ্মণ ৷
শ্রীরামের দাস্য তিঁহো কৈল অনুক্ষণ ॥ ৮৮ ॥

tām̐ra avatāra āna śrī-yuta lakṣmaṇa
His avatāra another the glorious Lakṣmaṇa
śrī-rāmera dāsya tim̐ho kaila anukṣaṇa
Śrī Rāma’s service he did constantly

88Another avatāra of His is the glorious Lakṣmaṇa, who served Śrī Rāma at every moment.

সঙ্কর্ষণ-অবতার কারণাব্ধিশায়ী ৷
তাঁহার হৃদয়ে ভক্ত-ভাব অনুয়ায়ী ॥ ৮৯ ॥

saṅkarṣaṇa-avatāra kāraṇābdhi-śāyī
of Saṅkarṣaṇa the avatāra in the Causal Ocean lying
tām̐hāra hṛdaye bhakta-bhāva anuyāyī
His in the heart the devotee’s mood accordingly

89The avatāra of Saṅkarṣaṇa who lies in the Causal Ocean likewise bears the mood of a devotee in His heart.

তাঁহার প্রকাশ-ভেদ, অদ্বৈত-আচার্য্য ৷
কায়মনোবাক্যে তাঁর ভক্তি সদা কার্য্য ॥ ৯০ ॥

tām̐hāra prakāśa-bheda, advaita-ācārya
His manifestation distinct Advaita Ācārya
kāya-mano-vākye tām̐ra bhakti sadā kārya
in body mind speech His devotion always the work

90A distinct manifestation of His is Advaita Ācārya, whose work at every moment is devotion to the Lord in body, mind and speech.

বাক্যে কহে, মুঞি চৈতন্যের অনুচর ৷
মুঞি তাঁর ভক্ত — মনে ভাবে নিরন্তর ॥ ৯১ ॥

vākye kahe, muñi caitanyera anucara
in words He says I Caitanya’s attendant
muñi tām̐ra bhakta — mane bhāve nirantara
I His devotee in His mind He thinks constantly

91In words He says, “I am Caitanya’s attendant,” and in His mind He thinks at every moment, “I am His devotee.”

জল-তুলসী দিয়া করে কায়াতে সেবন ৷
ভক্তি প্রচারিয়া সব তারিলা ভুবন ॥ ৯২ ॥

jala-tulasī diyā kare kāyāte sevana
water tulasī offering He does with the body service
bhakti pracāriyā saba tārilā bhuvana
bhakti spreading all He delivered the world

92With His body He serves, offering water and tulasī, and by spreading bhakti He has delivered the whole world.

পৃথিবী ধরেন যেই শেষ-সঙ্কর্ষণ ৷
কায়ব্যূহ করি’ করেন কৃষ্ণের সেবন ॥ ৯৩ ॥

pṛthivī dharena yei śeṣa-saṅkarṣaṇa
the earth holds who Śeṣa-Saṅkarṣaṇa
kāya-vyūha kari’ karena kṛṣṇera sevana
bodily expansions making does Kṛṣṇa’s service

93Śeṣa-Saṅkarṣaṇa, who holds up the earth, expands Himself into many bodies to serve Kṛṣṇa.40

এই সব হয় শ্রীকৃষ্ণের অবতার ৷
নিরন্তর দেখি সবার ভক্তির আচার ॥ ৯৪ ॥

ei saba haya śrī-kṛṣṇera avatāra
these all are Śrī Kṛṣṇa’s avatāras
nirantara dekhi sabāra bhaktira ācāra
constantly we see of all devotion’s conduct

94All these are avatāras of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, yet we always see Them conduct Themselves as devotees.

এ সবাকে শাস্ত্রে কহে ‘ভক্ত-অবতার’ ৷
‘ভক্ত-অবতার’ পদ উপরি সবার ॥ ৯৫ ॥

e sabāke śāstre kahe ‘bhakta-avatāra’
these all the scriptures call devotee-avatāras
‘bhakta-avatāra’ pada upari sabāra
the devotee-avatāra’s position above all

95The scriptures call all of Them devotee-avatāras, and the position of a devotee-avatāra is above all others.41

একমাত্র ‘অংশী’ — কৃষ্ণ, ‘অংশ’ — অবতার ৷
অংশী-অংশে দেখি জ্যেষ্ঠ-কনিষ্ঠ-আচার ॥ ৯৬ ॥

eka-mātra ‘aṁśī’ — kṛṣṇa, ‘aṁśa’ — avatāra
the one and only whole Kṛṣṇa parts the avatāras
aṁśī-aṁśe dekhi jyeṣṭha-kaniṣṭha-ācāra
in whole and part we see of elder younger the conduct

96Kṛṣṇa alone is the whole (aṁśī); the avatāras are His parts (aṁśa). And between the whole and the part we see the conduct of elder and younger.42

জ্যেষ্ঠ-ভাবে অংশীতে হয় প্রভু-জ্ঞান ৷
কনিষ্ঠ-ভাবে আপনাতে ভক্ত-অভিমান ॥ ৯৭ ॥

jyeṣṭha-bhāve aṁśīte haya prabhu-jñāna
in the elder’s mood in the whole is the Master’s awareness
kaniṣṭha-bhāve āpanāte bhakta-abhimāna
in the younger’s mood in oneself the devotee’s self-conception

97In the mood of the elder, the whole is conscious of being the Master; in the mood of the younger, the part thinks of Himself as a devotee.43

কৃষ্ণের সমতা হৈতে বড় ভক্তপদ ৷
আত্মা হৈতে কৃষ্ণের ভক্ত হয় প্রেমাস্পদ ॥ ৯৮ ॥

kṛṣṇera samatā haite baḍa bhakta-pada
than equality with Kṛṣṇa greater the devotee’s position
ātmā haite kṛṣṇera bhakta haya premāspada
than His own self more Kṛṣṇa’s devotee is beloved

98Greater than equality with Kṛṣṇa is the position of a devotee, for Kṛṣṇa’s devotee is dearer to Him than His own self.44

আত্মা হৈতে কৃষ্ণ ভক্তে বড় করি’ মানে ৷
ইহাতে বহুত শাস্ত্র-বচন প্রমাণে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

ātmā haite kṛṣṇa bhakte baḍa kari’ māne
than Himself Kṛṣṇa the devotee greater as regards
ihāte bahuta śāstra-vacana pramāṇe
of this many scriptures’ words are the proof

99Kṛṣṇa regards His devotee as greater than Himself, and many words of scripture prove it.

ন তথা মে প্রিয়তম আত্ম-যোনির্ন শঙ্করঃ ৷
ন চ সঙ্কর্ষণো ন শ্রীর্নৈবাত্মা চ যথা ভবান্ ॥ ১০০ ॥

na tathā me priya-tama
not so to Me dear
ātma-yonir na śaṅkaraḥ
Brahmā not Śaṅkara
na ca saṅkarṣaṇo na śrīr
not and Saṅkarṣaṇa not Śrī
naivātmā ca yathā bhavān
not even My own self and as you

100“Neither Brahmā, born of Me, nor Śaṅkara, nor Saṅkarṣaṇa, nor Śrī, nor even My own self is as dear to Me as you are.” (Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, 11.14.15)45

কৃষ্ণসাম্যে নহে তাঁর মাধুর্য্যাস্বাদন ৷
ভক্তভাবে করে তাঁর মাধুর্য্য চর্ব্বণ ॥ ১০১ ॥

kṛṣṇa-sāmye nahe tām̐ra mādhuryāsvādana
in equality with Kṛṣṇa is not His sweetness’ tasting
bhakta-bhāve kare tām̐ra mādhurya carvaṇa
in the devotee’s mood does His sweetness relishing

101In equality with Kṛṣṇa there is no tasting of His sweetness; it is in the mood of a devotee that one relishes it.46

শাস্ত্রের সিদ্ধান্ত এই, — বিজ্ঞের অনুভব ৷
মূঢ়লোক নাহি জানে ভাবের বৈভব ॥ ১০২ ॥

śāstrera siddhānta ei, — vijñera anubhava
of the scriptures the conclusion this of the wise the experience
mūḍha-loka nāhi jāne bhāvera vaibhava
foolish people not know of the mood the glory

102This is the conclusion of the scriptures and the experience of the wise; foolish people do not know the glory of this mood.

ভক্তভাব অঙ্গীকরি’ বলরাম, লক্ষ্মণ ৷
অদ্বৈত, নিত্যানন্দ, শেষ, সঙ্কর্ষণ ॥ ১০৩ ॥

কৃষ্ণের মাধুর্য্যরসামৃত করে পান ৷
সেই সুখে মত্ত, কিছু নাহি জানে আন ॥ ১০৪ ॥

bhakta-bhāva aṅgīkari’ balarāma, lakṣmaṇa
the devotee’s mood accepting Balarāma Lakṣmaṇa
advaita, nityānanda, śeṣa, saṅkarṣaṇa
Advaita Nityānanda Śeṣa Saṅkarṣaṇa
kṛṣṇera mādhurya-rasāmṛta kare pāna
Kṛṣṇa’s sweetness’ nectar of rasa they drink
sei sukhe matta, kichu nāhi jāne āna
in that happiness intoxicated anything not know else

103–104Accepting the mood of devotees, Balarāma, Lakṣmaṇa, Advaita, Nityānanda, Śeṣa and Saṅkarṣaṇa drink the nectar of Kṛṣṇa’s sweetness; intoxicated with that happiness, They know nothing else.47

অন্যের আছুক্ কার্য্য, আপনে শ্রীকৃষ্ণ ৷
আপন-মাধুর্য্য-পানে হইলা সতৃষ্ণ ॥ ১০৫ ॥

anyera āchuk kārya, āpane śrī-kṛṣṇa
of others let it be the matter Himself Śrī Kṛṣṇa
āpana-mādhurya-pāne hailā satṛṣṇa
His own sweetness to drink became thirsty

105Let alone others: Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself became thirsty to drink His own sweetness.

স্বমাধুর্য্য আস্বাদিতে করেন যতন ৷
ভক্তভাব বিনু নহে তাহা আস্বাদন ॥ ১০৬ ॥

svamādhurya āsvādite karena yatana
His own sweetness to taste He makes effort
bhakta-bhāva vinu nahe tāhā āsvādana
the devotee’s mood without is not its tasting

106He strives to taste His own sweetness, but without the mood of a devotee it cannot be tasted.

ভক্তভাব অঙ্গীকরি’ হৈলা অবতীর্ণ ৷
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচৈতন্যরূপে সর্ব্বভাবে পূর্ণ ॥ ১০৭ ॥

bhakta-bhāva aṅgīkari’ hailā avatīrṇa
the devotee’s mood accepting He became descended
śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya-rūpe sarva-bhāve pūrṇa
in the form of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya in all moods full

107So, accepting the mood of a devotee, He descended in the form of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, full of every mood (bhāva).48

নানা-ভক্তভাবে করেন স্বমাধুর্য্য পান ৷
পূর্ব্বে করিয়াছি এই সিদ্ধান্ত ব্যাখ্যান ॥ ১০৮ ॥

nānā-bhakta-bhāve karena sva-mādhurya pāna
in various devotees’ moods He makes of His own sweetness drinking
pūrve kariyāchi ei siddhānta vyākhyāna
before I have made of this conclusion the explanation

108In the moods of various devotees He drinks His own sweetness. I have explained this conclusion before.49

অবতারগণের ভক্তভাবে অধিকার ৷
ভক্তভাব হৈতে অধিক সুখ নাহি আর ॥ ১০৯ ॥

avatāra-gaṇera bhakta-bhāve adhikāra
of the avatāras in the devotee’s mood the right
bhakta-bhāva haite adhika sukha nāhi āra
than the devotee’s mood greater happiness is not other

109All the avatāras have a claim to the mood of a devotee; there is no happiness greater than that of the devotee’s mood.

মূল-ভক্ত-অবতার শ্রীসঙ্কর্ষণ ৷
ভক্ত-অবতার তঁহি অদ্বৈতে গণন ॥ ১১০ ॥

mūla-bhakta-avatāra śrī-saṅkarṣaṇa
the original devotee-avatāra Śrī Saṅkarṣaṇa
bhakta-avatāra tam̐hi advaite gaṇana
devotee-avatāra among them Advaita is counted

110The original devotee-avatāra is Śrī Saṅkarṣaṇa, and among the devotee-avatāras Advaita too is counted.50

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য্য গোসাঞির মহিমা অপার ৷
যাঁহার হুঙ্কারে কৈল চৈতন্যাবতার ॥ ১১১ ॥

advaita-ācārya gosāñira mahimā apāra
Advaita Ācārya Gosāñi’s glory boundless
yām̐hāra huṅkāre kaila caitanyāvatāra
by whose roar was made Caitanya’s descent

111The glory of Advaita Ācārya Gosāñi is boundless: it was by His roar that Caitanya descended.

সঙ্কীর্ত্তন প্রচারিয়া সব জগৎ তারিল ৷
অদ্বৈত-প্রসাদে লোক প্রেমধন পাইল ॥ ১১২ ॥

saṅkīrtana pracāriyā saba jagat tārila
saṅkīrtana spreading all the world He delivered
advaita-prasāde loka prema-dhana pāila
by Advaita’s grace people the treasure of prema obtained

112By spreading saṅkīrtana He delivered the whole world; by Advaita’s grace people obtained the treasure of prema.

অদ্বৈত-মহিমা অনন্ত কে পারে কহিতে ৷
সেই লিখি, যেই শুনি মহাজন হৈতে ॥ ১১৩ ॥

advaita-mahimā ananta ke pāre kahite
Advaita’s glory endless who can tell
sei likhi, yei śuni mahājana haite
that I write which I have heard great souls from

113Who can tell the endless glory of Advaita? I write only what I have heard from great souls.

আচার্য্য-চরণে মোর কোটি নমস্কার ৷
ইথে কিছু অপরাধ না লবে আমার ॥ ১১৪ ॥

ācārya-caraṇe mora koṭi namaskāra
at the Ācārya’s feet my millions of obeisances
ithe kichu aparādha nā labe āmāra
in this any offence not may He take mine

114Millions of times I bow at the Ācārya’s feet. May He not count any offence of mine in this.

তোমার মহিমা — কোটিসমুদ্র অগাধ ৷
তাহার ইয়ত্তা কহি — এ বড় অপরাধ ॥ ১১৫ ॥

tomāra mahimā — koṭi-samudra agādha
Your glory (like) millions of oceans fathomless
tāhāra iyattā kahi — e baḍa aparādha
its measure I tell this great offence

115Your glory is as fathomless as millions of oceans; to speak of its measure is a great offence.

জয় জয় জয় শ্রীঅদ্বৈত আচার্য্য ৷
জয় জয় শ্রীচৈতন্য, নিত্যানন্দ আর্য্য ॥ ১১৬ ॥

jaya jaya jaya śrī-advaita ācārya
glory glory glory to Śrī Advaita Ācārya
jaya jaya śrī-caitanya, nityānanda ārya
glory glory to Śrī Caitanya to Nityānanda the venerable

116Glory, glory, glory to Śrī Advaita Ācārya! Glory, glory to Śrī Caitanya and to the venerable Nityānanda!

দুই শ্লোকে কহিল অদ্বৈত-তত্ত্বনিরূপণ ৷
পঞ্চতত্ত্বের বিচার কিছু শুন, ভক্তগণ ॥ ১১৭ ॥

dui śloke kahila advaita-tattva-nirūpaṇa
in two verses I have told of Advaita’s truth the determination
pañca-tattvera vicāra kichu śuna, bhakta-gaṇa
of the Pañca-tattva the consideration a little hear O devotees

117In two verses I have set out the truth of Advaita. Now, O devotees, hear something of the Pañca-tattva.

শ্রীরূপ-রঘুনাথ-পদে যার আশ ৷
চৈতন্যচরিতামৃত কহে কৃষ্ণদাস ॥ ১১৮ ॥

śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
Śrī Rūpa’s, Raghunātha’s at the feet whose hope
caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
“Caitanya-caritāmṛta” narrates Kṛṣṇadāsa

118Praying at the feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate the Caitanya-caritāmṛta.

✦

Notes

  1. The same verse as Ādi 1.12. The edition ascribes verses 6.4–6.5 to the diary of Svarūpa Dāmodara («শ্রীস্বরূপগোস্বামি-কড়চায় শ্লোক»; heading: “explanation of the twelfth and thirteenth of the first fourteen verses of the Ādi”). Anubhāṣya: Mahā-Viṣṇu, the maker of the world, is the shelter of the efficient cause (nimitta), and His avatāra, the Lord Advaita Ācārya, is the shelter of the material cause (upādāna).
  2. The same verse as Ādi 1.13. Anubhāṣya: He is Advaita because He is non-different from Hari, from the Viṣṇu-tattva; He is Ācārya because He instructs others in bhajana.
  3. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: one and the same māyā is called pradhāna as the material cause and māyā as the efficient cause. According to these two functions Mahā-Viṣṇu abides in two forms: in one, abiding in prakṛti, He is the efficient cause of the world — the form of Viṣṇu; in the other, abiding in pradhāna, He is Advaita in the form of Rudra. Therefore Advaita is in no way different from the Puruṣa; only Their bodies differ.
  4. The edition’s heading: “The Deity who presides over pradhāna, the material cause of the world.”
  5. Anubhāṣya: Śrī Advaita is Mahā-Viṣṇu, and He is the Ācārya; His life, turned towards service, brings good to all; He is no material being and no shelter of the material guṇas. There were people of demoniac nature, bewildered by māyā and devoid of bhakti, who could not understand Him as the non-dual Viṣṇu and, clinging to the doctrine of bare non-duality (kevalādvaita), only pretended to follow Him; by His māyā the Ācārya let them feed their pride — and even this punishment of the faithless is nothing but auspicious conduct. Some say that Śrī Advaita’s other name was Maṅgala.
  6. Anubhāṣya (on 6.15) examines the Sāṅkhya doctrine at length and, following the Vedānta-sūtra (2.2.1–10) and Baladeva Vidyābhūṣaṇa’s Govinda-bhāṣya, shows that inert pradhāna can be neither the material nor the efficient cause of the world, for a varied creation is impossible without a conscious principle. It adds that the Kapila who founded the Sāṅkhya opposed to the Vedas is not Lord Kapila, the son of Kardama and avatāra of Vāsudeva, but another — a jīva of the line of Agni, bewildered by māyā. On 6.18–6.19 the Anubhāṣya refers to Ādi 5.58–5.66 and Madhya 20.259–261, 271, 276.
  7. The edition’s heading: “The two forms of Advaita Prabhu.” The form in which the Puruṣa enters each universe (6.9) is Garbhodakaśāyī Viṣṇu.
  8. The Anubhāṣya refers to Ādi 3.67 (“‘aṅga’ means ‘aṁśa’”).
  9. The same verse as Ādi 2.30 and 3.68 (Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: “see Ādi 2.30”, where the Anubhāṣya explains the three meanings of the name Nārāyaṇa). Here the author cites it for the word aṅgam, “part”: Nārāyaṇa is Your aṅga, that is, Your aṁśa (6.21).
  10. The edition’s heading: “Whether aṅga or aṁśa, beyond māyā.” The Anubhāṣya refers to Ādi 3.69–3.70.
  11. The edition’s heading: “The meaning of the name ‘Advaita’.” Pūrṇa nāma — “a full name”, a name true in every respect.
  12. Anubhāṣya (on 6.26–6.28): although Advaita Prabhu is Viṣṇu-tattva, the One who is served, He has no work but the good of the souls — awakening in them the desire to serve. Had He shown His pastimes only as the One who is served, the pleasure-seeking people of the world would have imitated Him and become godless adherents of bare non-duality, or worshippers of themselves as God; seeing this, He displayed the pastime of a servant of Viṣṇu, and that is His being the Ācārya. As for the wicked who defile the holy place and dress of the Ācārya and, instead of serving the Lord, dance the dance of sense-pleasure, the Ācārya utterly rejects them.
  13. The edition’s heading: “The meaning of the name ‘Kamalākṣa’.” Avataṁsa — “a crown, an ornament”: Kamalākṣa is the loveliest of names.
  14. As in the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition: «তুলসীদলে» (“with tulasī leaves”; another reading: «তুলসীজলে», “with tulasī and water”). The edition’s heading: “Advaita Prabhu calls Mahāprabhu down.” On 6.33–6.34 the Anubhāṣya refers to Ādi 3.91 and 3.95–3.108, where Advaita worships Kṛṣṇa with tulasī leaves and Ganges water.
  15. The edition’s heading: “One limb of Gaura is Advaita, the other is Nitāi.” On 6.36–6.38 the Anubhāṣya refers to Ādi 3.71–3.74.
  16. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: Advaita Prabhu is a disciple of Mādhavendra Purī, and His godbrother Īśvara Purī is Mahāprabhu’s guru; that is why Mahāprabhu honours the Ācārya as a guru. In truth Śrī Caitanya is the Lord of all and Advaita is His servant. Anubhāṣya: Mādhavendra Purī is one of the gurus of the sampradāya of Śrī Madhvācārya, and his disciples are Īśvara Purī and Śrī Advaita; the line of succession is cited from the Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā.
  17. Anubhāṣya: accepting the mood of a devotee, Mahā-Viṣṇu sets aside the sense of His own majesty and finds bliss in serving the Lord as His duty; in that bliss of service His sense of being the enjoyer recedes. By His own example He moves the souls to serve Kṛṣṇa at every moment.
  18. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: the happiness of Brahman is the happiness of the notion of non-difference, “I am Brahman.” The Anubhāṣya cites the Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu (1.1.38): “Even if the bliss of Brahman were multiplied a parārdha times, it would not equal an atom of the ocean of the happiness of bhakti.”
  19. As in the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition: «নারদাদি» (“Nārada and others”; another reading: «নারদার»). The edition’s heading: “(2) The associates of Viṣṇu, and Brahmā, Śiva, the four Sanas, Nārada, Śuka and others too, are servants of Kṛṣṇa.”
  20. As in the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition: «হইল» (another reading: «হইলা»); the sense is the same. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: āgala — “the foremost”.
  21. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: “elders” are those related to Kṛṣṇa in parental love, “equals” — the friends, “juniors” — those beneath them; love for Kṛṣṇa gives all three the mood of service. So the elders, equals and juniors of Kṛṣṇa Caitanya are all His servants.
  22. The edition’s heading: “(5) Even in Nanda Mahārāja’s parental love there is service to Kṛṣṇa.” Guru here means “elder” (Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya on 6.52).
  23. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya on 6.58: “O Uddhava, even if you think that Kṛṣṇa is God, may my mind rest in that Kṛṣṇa.” Nanda prays for attachment to the Kṛṣṇa whom Uddhava calls God — this is the “semblance of service” (6.55) of which the author speaks.
  24. Anubhāṣya: Nanda and the other cowherds speak these words to Uddhava with deep love for Kṛṣṇa when, having met the people of Vraja, he is about to set out on his way back.
  25. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: friendship is of two kinds — with knowledge of Kṛṣṇa’s majesty, and “pure” (kevala), unmixed; Śrīdāmā and the other friends of Vraja have pure friendship: they do not know His majesty.
  26. As in the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition: «তাঁরা» (another reading: «তারা»); the sense is the same.
  27. Anubhāṣya: so the cowherd boys played with Rāma and Kṛṣṇa in Tālavana, before Dhenukāsura was slain. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: the other friends, in the mood of friendship, fanned Him with fans made of leaves.
  28. Anubhāṣya: this is the song of the gopīs as they searched for Kṛṣṇa when He had vanished during the rāsa dance. Vraja-janārti-han — “who destroys the pain of separation of those attached to Kṛṣṇa”; vīra — “of magnificent form”; bhaja — “be gracious to us”; yoṣitām goes with “show us women (the gopīs)”. The Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya reads it otherwise: “O supreme hero among women.”
  29. As in the Gauḍīya Maṭha edition: «কিঙ্করীণাং» (another reading: «কিঙ্করিণাং»). Anubhāṣya: this is the citra-jalpa of Śrīmatī Rādhikā, addressed to the bee when Uddhava came to Vraja; ārya-putra is the son of Nanda; “kinsmen” — Parjanya, Upananda and others, “cowherds” — Subala, Arjuna, Śrīdāmā and others; “maidservants” — Lalitā, Viśākhā and Rādhā’s other friends. The Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya takes “gentle one” as Uddhava.
  30. The edition’s heading: “(8) Even Śrī Rādhā Herself is a maidservant of Kṛṣṇa.”
  31. Anubhāṣya: so Śrīmatī Rādhikā weeps when, during the rāsa dance, Kṛṣṇa had left the other gopīs and gone away with Her alone, and then, when She, proud of His love, said She could walk no further and asked Him to carry Her, He vanished. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: “O Master, O Beloved, O Dearest, O mighty-armed! I am Your most wretched maidservant — bring Me near You!”
  32. Anubhāṣya: these are the words of Kālindī, Kṛṣṇa’s queen, to Draupadī, when the women of the Yādavas and the Kauravas met at Samanta-pañcaka; “His friend” is Arjuna.
  33. Anubhāṣya: in the same place Queen Lakṣmaṇā speaks to Draupadī: having renounced every attachment — to happiness, wealth, children, and even to liberation — we have become maidservants in the house of Kṛṣṇa, who delights in Himself.
  34. Anubhāṣya: although Baladeva is the elder brother and therefore worthy of worship, He knows Himself as the servant of His younger brother, Kṛṣṇa. The fourfold expansion of Mahā-Vaikuṇṭha is a manifestation of this self-luminous Baladeva, and even so exalted a position abides in service to Kṛṣṇa. As far as a being has turned away from Kṛṣṇa’s service, so far has it invited misfortune.
  35. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: the ten bodies are the umbrella, slippers, bed, pillow, garments, ornaments, resting place, dwelling, sacred thread and throne.
  36. Anubhāṣya (following the Laghu-bhāgavatāmṛta): the scriptures speak of Rudra in two ways. Śiva who is the Lord’s own part (svāṁśa) is counted among the lords (īśvara-koṭi), while Rudra the destroyer is in some kalpas a particular jīva, like Brahmā. Hara, the abode of the Puruṣa, is in essence almost free of the guṇas and only appears changeable through his contact with tamas — as milk turns into curd by contact with a culture and yet is not other than milk (Brahma-saṁhitā 5.45). Sadāśiva, who dwells in Śivaloka within Vaikuṇṭha and is free from tamas, is a vilāsa of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
  37. Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya: whatever the mood one has, the mood of service within every mood must be acknowledged. The edition’s heading: “(13) Service to Kṛṣṇa runs through all four rasas — mādhurya, vātsalya, sakhya and dāsya.”
  38. Anubhāṣya: service to Śrī Caitanya is the very nature (svarūpa-dharma) of the jīva, an atom of spirit. Forgetting it, the bound soul is drawn to material enjoyment; yet even then, lording it over things, it remains an unworthy servant of Caitanya.
  39. The edition’s heading: “Baladeva and all His partial avatāras think of themselves as Kṛṣṇa’s servants.”
  40. Anubhāṣya: kāya-vyūha — the ten bodies (see 6.76).
  41. Anubhāṣya: when the Lord descends into the world to display His majesty, the image of the devotee-avatāra is the most precious and needful for the good of the souls and for awakening bhajana in them. Looking with worldly eyes at avatāras in whom majesty predominates, souls often come to grief: many fools call themselves “Vāsudeva” and the like and after death are born as jackals. Pride, intoxicating the bound soul with a longing for divine majesty, turns it into a Māyāvādī.
  42. The edition’s heading: “The elder-and-younger conduct of the partial avatāras towards Kṛṣṇa, the whole.”
  43. Anubhāṣya: a part is called aṁśa, and that of which it is a part, aṁśī; the whole is the Master (prabhu), the part is the devotee, and their relation is that of elder and younger: the elder is called the Master, the younger the devotee. The whole is Kṛṣṇa; the parts are Baladeva and the manifestations of Mahā-Viṣṇu of the same nature as He. Kṛṣṇa knows Himself as the Master, Baladeva and the others know themselves as devotees. The edition’s heading: “The elder partial avatāra sees the younger whole as his Master, and the younger partial avatāra thinks of himself as the servant of the elder whole” — as Baladeva before Kṛṣṇa, and Lakṣmaṇa before Rāma.
  44. Anubhāṣya: the devotee’s position — service to Kṛṣṇa — is higher than any claim to equality with Him, for Kṛṣṇa loves His servants more than He loves Himself. The best witness to this is the Bhāgavatam (9.4.68): “The saints are My heart, and I am the heart of the saints. They know no one but Me, and I know no one but them.”
  45. Anubhāṣya: Kṛṣṇa speaks to Uddhava, the best of His devotees; ātmā — “I Myself, even My own form”.
  46. Anubhāṣya (on 6.101–6.102): in the liberations of sārūpya and the rest, as in the position of Viṣṇu-tattva, equality with Kṛṣṇa keeps the sweetness of His service from being tasted as it is in the devotee’s mood; the devotee claims no equality with Kṛṣṇa as an enjoyer, and therefore he fully realises His sweetness, as if savouring it. Ordinary people, out of folly and greed for mastery, are by nature unable to feel the summit of service; only the experienced, deeply immersed in the scriptures, understand this subtle truth.
  47. The edition’s heading: “Nityānanda, Rāma and the other forms of Viṣṇu taste Kṛṣṇa’s sweetness by accepting the devotee’s mood.”
  48. Anubhāṣya (on 6.107–6.108): to taste the five rasas — śānta, dāsya, sakhya, vātsalya and mādhurya — Śrī Gaurahari accepted the moods of devotees, and so He is full of every bhāva; taking up the moods of devotees of different kinds, Gauracandra drinks His own sweetness. On 6.106: to know how His devotees taste His sweetness, He Himself became a devotee.
  49. Before — in Ādi 4: on 6.105–6.106 the Anubhāṣya refers to Ādi 4.137–4.158.
  50. Anubhāṣya: Advaita Prabhu, though He is Viṣṇu-tattva, displayed the pastime of a servant befitting an associate of Śrī Caitanya; that the Viṣṇu-tattva thinks of Himself as a servant is what makes Him a devotee-avatāra. Śrī Saṅkarṣaṇa, who abides in Mahā-Vaikuṇṭha as the Lord of the fourfold expansion, is the original devotee-avatāra; from Him comes Mahā-Viṣṇu in the waters of the Causal Ocean, and Śrī Advaita Ācārya is the avatāra of that Mahā-Viṣṇu. All the manifestations of Saṅkarṣaṇa are engaged in the service of Kṛṣṇa, the original form, and therefore Advaita Prabhu is the servant of Gaura-Kṛṣṇa, a devotee-avatāra.
